query:
select (i.base_unit_id <> $2 or i.track_lot <> $3 or i.track_expiry <> $4)
                  and exists (select 1 from stock_lot sl
                              join stock_movement m on m.lot_id = sl.id
                              where sl.item_id = i.id) as "locked!"
           from item i
           where i.id = $1
